summary: The diff implements Array.prototype.shift in order against the spec: ToObject, LengthOfArrayLike, the length-0 branch (Set length +0, return undefined), Get "0", the k loop (ToString keys before HasProperty, Get/Set or DeletePropertyOrThrow per the fromPresent branch), DeletePropertyOrThrow on length-1, Set length to length-1, and return first. Every abrupt completion is propagated with `?`. No test-specific branches, hardcoded values, or swallowed errors. The only things I could not verify are in the GC root helpers, which were not in the diff: whether with_roots truncates the root stack when the closure returns Err (the `?` paths skip pop_roots), and whether push_root's returned mark is the pre-push length as pop_roots expects. Neither is a spec or observable-behaviour defect.
notes_for_next_attempt: No defects found. Worth confirming under KAHVI_GC_STRESS=1 that with_roots restores the root stack on the error path, since the early `?` returns inside the loop skip pop_roots.
